items.title: Pay alleged collection debt
items.quote: Überweisen Sie den Betrag bis zum 22.10.2025 auf das Konto IBAN BG30 BUIN 9561 1000 4728 10, Empfänger: V. Dimitrova.
items.computation: The letter states a fixed calendar date for payment ('bis zum 22.10.2025'), not a period to be counted. 22 October 2025 is a Wednesday, not a weekend day or a public holiday in NRW or nationwide, so no shift under §193 BGB is needed. The due date is used exactly as printed.

warnings: This letter shows strong hallmarks of a fake/predatory debt-collection scam for a dubious 'Gewinnspiel-Eintragungsservice' (prize-draw registration service) allegedly ordered by phone: a foreign (Bulgarian) IBAN, a payee name (V. Dimitrova) that does not match the sending company, aggressive threats of wage garnishment and account blocking without any court order or title, a demand to pay within days, and a claim that objecting is impossible.

The statement 'Ein Widerspruch ist ausgeschlossen' (an objection is excluded) has no legal basis — a consumer always retains the right to dispute a claimed debt, and a private collection agency cannot lawfully garnish wages or freeze a bank account without a court title.
Restricting contact to e-mail only ('Rückfragen nur per E-Mail') is a common tactic to avoid verification by phone and should be treated as a red flag.

Before paying anything, verify the alleged June 2025 telephone order and the claimed company/mandate independently (e.g. via a consumer protection center, Verbraucherzentrale) rather than using the bank details given in this letter.
Do not use the supplied IBAN (foreign account, individual payee name) to send any money.
